description: A map of the repository that fits a token budget.

map.description: The map: each directory as path/ (the root as ./), each file below it indented two spaces, and its declarations after it as <kind> <name> L<line>, joined by ·.

estimated_tokens.description: The size of the map in tokens, estimated as its bytes divided by 4, rounded up. At most the budget.

level.description: The first level of the ladder whose output fits the budget: 1 every declaration; 2 none for test files; 3 the declarations of other files capped at 20, 10, 5, 2 or 1, with … +N more; 4 file names only; 5 directories only, as path/ (N files); 6 directories cut off at the budget, then … N more directories.

files_total.description: The files in the file view.

files_outlined.description: The files whose declarations were read; 0 when the outliner was skipped.
